capabilities.why: Intercepts all agent and pipeline tool commands prior to dispatching them to the sandbox container. Enforces default-deny AST parsing, command tokenization, path isolation under /workspace/case, and blocks dangerous metacharacters and exfiltration tools before the guest ever sees them.

Enables resuming container state across mid-task step failures. Under the Step 7 failure policy, the sandbox disk and environment are preserved to allow immediate in-place retry of test executions without paying re-provisioning latency or repeating expensive reasoning.
